english.title: Use on a road an unbraked wheeled trailer with no conspicuous external nearside marking of max gross weight
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), used on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), an unbraked wheeled trailer which did not have its maximum gross weight plainly marked in a conspicuous place on the outside of the vehicle on its nearside
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 71(2)(b) of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 41B of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:

english.notes:
(i) See regulation 71(1)(d) for exceptions.
(ii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Fixed penalty ticket - Fifty pounds.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
